title: code::dive conference 2014 - Scott Meyers: Cpu Caches and Why You Care
summary: Scott Meyers explains how CPU caches work and why they matter for performance, covering cache levels, access speeds, associativity, and effects in multithreaded code. The focus is C++ and cache-aware, data-oriented programming.
why: HN points to it as the go-to explanation of why memory layout beats pointer-chasing structures on real hardware.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Scott Meyers had a very good talk which contained this information
